correctness.rationale: For antiunitary A, T=(A+A^{-1})/2 has identical quadratic form; symmetric polarization gives w(A)=||T||. Since T^2=(I+A^2)^*(I+A^2)/4, this equals half the norm of I+A^2. Exact Cauchy-Schwarz optimization over q-constrained pairs yields R_rho. Connectedness and circular symmetry give the complete disk; equality iff the quadratic radius is attained in the r>=rho regime. Spectral calculus and a fixed vector of the top antilinear involution equate attainment with E_{A^2}(Gamma_rho) nonzero, including zero-radius cases. Rotation-block direct sums realize nonattaining spectral limits. A standalone checker passed 603 finite diagnostics, not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Theorem 6.6 of the 2026 motivating paper proves disk shape but leaves both exact radius and the open/closed alternative unspecified. This classification resolves both for all antiunitaries, and distinct infinite-dimensional direct sums with identical radius functions but different boundary inclusion demonstrate that the spectral projection condition expresses information not reducible to a numerical scalar. Exact transition at |q|=rho is structurally motivated by nonattainment in the continuous spectrum.
